title: Toddler in Overalls, Spraying Garden Hose - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming outdoor snapshot capturing a smiling young toddler dressed in bib overalls standing on a grassy lawn while holding a garden hose with a spray nozzle. The water sprays outwards toward the left of the frame in the bright sunlight. In the background are manicured hedges and tall trees. The reverse side features black paper remnants from an old photo album and a stamped production number '690'.
